ses.not: The music is temporary; your own music will replace it. Drag to zero to turn it off.
gezme.ipucu: Drag with one finger; rotate, zoom and tilt with two
gezme.fotoNot: Added to the gallery. Press and hold the picture to save it.
ipucu.altlik: Check the order, pick a cone or a cup
ipucu.siparisVar: A customer is here, go to the counter!
ipucu.suslemeKaldir: No {ad} wanted: tap again to remove it
haber.gunBasladi: Day {gun} has begun, the shop is open
haber.sikildi: A customer got tired of waiting and left
haber.bahsis: {seri} perfect servings in a row: +{miktar} tip
haber.deneme: Test shop: try anything here until release. Your own save is safe
ipucu.hazirlik: Good morning! Your shop is waiting. Start the day when you're ready.
ipucu.tepsiyeKoy: They want two ice creams: put this one on the tray
ipucu.kapandi: The shop is closed; last ice creams for those inside
ipucu.kuvet: Hold on a tub, release while the needle is green
ipucu.servisVeyaTop: One more scoop, a topping, or serve!
sonuc.sikildi: The customer got tired and left
acilis.yeniSoru: Your saved shop will be deleted. Start a new game?
cesit.yildizNot: Some flavors can be bought once customer satisfaction rises: an average of 4, 4.5 and 4.75 stars. Once unlocked, they stay unlocked. Your best average so far: {ortalama}
vitrin.enBuyuk: The display is at its largest: 12 tubs
insaat.ipucu: Tap a square or a wall. Green is yours, yellow can be bought, grey can't be bought yet.
insaat.kilitli: Buy the square next to it first
insaat.terasDuvarsiz: The terrace stays without walls all year
insaat.orulemez: A wall must touch the indoor area
insaat.yikilamaz: Can't knock down: a counter section or the only door is here, or the shop would be split in two
insaat.tezgahNot: Moves within the indoor area. Leaves 1 m for the customer line in front.
vitrin.otomatikAciklama: Every morning yesterday's best sellers and one new flavor
vitrin.elle: Manual: tap a flavor to add it to or remove it from the display
vitrin.not: Customers only ask for flavors in the display. New flavors are bought in Improve the shop.
fiyat.not: The slider sets a flavor's price; Overall price adds a discount or a markup to all of them. A flavor priced above fair is asked for less often; if it's very expensive, customers are a little less happy.
fiyat.pahali.etki: customers come less often and are a little less happy
dekor.etki: Items you buy go to storage. At the start of the day tap “Place” in the shop, pick the item and tap the floor. Placed items' comfort makes customers a little happier; their appeal and the lights bring customers more often.
yerlestir.ipucu: Pick an item, then tap a green square. Tap a placed item to move it. More space is bought in Build.
yerlestir.bos: Your storage is empty. You can buy items in Improve the shop.
ipucu.hamur: Hold, release at the line: the batter pours
ipucu.pisiyor: Open the lid when it's golden brown
ipucu.waffleSusle: Add the toppings they want, then serve
istasyon.baslik: Which station are you at today?
istasyon.kurulmadi: Unlocks once a machine / stand and a second serving point are added in Build
istasyon.yardimcilar: Helpers · tap to change their spot
yardimci.not: Hiring costs {fiyat}, plus {yevmiye} in wages at the end of each day. At most {sayi} helpers. They take their stations when the day starts.
insaat.mutfakOlmaz: The kitchen can only go in the back rows, where there's no counter
ipucu.icecek: Take the drinks they want; hold prepared ones like coffee and milkshake, release in the zone
gorunus.deneniyor: You're trying it on; buy it if you like it. Closing brings back the old look.
gorunus.not: Switching between bought ones is free. You can rotate the shop with the buttons below.
tabela.not: You can put up several signs; tap a bought one to put it up or take it down. Light-up ones switch on by themselves in the evening.
dekor.icNot: Rugs lie on the floor; tables can go on top. A painting goes on the square next to a plain wall and hangs on that wall; in a corner, rotate it to move it to the other wall.
insaat.mutfakIpucu: Build a wall on a back square and “Add to kitchen” appears: a fridge and shelves come with it.
ekran.grafikNot: If the phone gets warm or stutters, pick Low: shadows, the far neighborhood and part of the crowd turn off.
galeri.bos: No photos yet. Pause and tap "Explore the shop" to take some.
galeri.albumBos: A photo of your shop is taken by itself on the first evening of every month and goes here.
haber.album: This month's photo of your shop went into the album
seviye.not: Serving, PERFECT scoops and golden waffles give the employee exp; earnings and stars give the shop exp. All of it also counts toward the main level. The shop level unlocks new items and flavors.
haber.seviye: Level {seviye}! Rewards at the end of the day
yetenek.not: The employee earns skill points with every level. Each skill's steps are taken in order; a step works right away.
yetenek.hizliEller.aciklama: Scoop and batter fill faster, waffles bake faster
haber.grup: A group of customers is coming
yorum.kucuk: The scoop was a bit small
yorum.buyuk: The scoop was a bit big
ekran.otoKamera: Go to the counter automatically when an order comes
insaat.tezgahMutfak: The kitchen is behind. To move the counter back, first pick that kitchen square and “Turn back into shop”.
insaat.tezgahKapali: The back isn't indoors. Buy the square behind and build a wall first.
insaat.mutfakTasi: To move the kitchen: “Turn back into shop” here, then “Add to kitchen” on another back square.
insaat.neYapalim: What would you like to do?
insaat.kareIpucu: Tap a square on the ground to buy land, build walls or add a kitchen.
insaat.duvarIpucu: Use the arrows to move along the wall; the selected piece glows white.
haber.kuvetBos: This tub is empty; refill it from Products → Stock
haber.icecekBitti: This drink is out; restock it from Products → Stock
haber.stokBitti: Out of stock: the shop closed early today. You can restock at the end of the day
stok.not: Customers don't ask for a flavour, cone, topping or drink that has run out. If everything runs out, the shop closes early that day; no penalty.
dekor.mutfakNot: Kitchen items go only on kitchen squares; shop items can't go in the kitchen.
arkaTezgah.not: Tap a slot, then an item: it goes there. Unbought items are bought first; once bought, an item can go in any slot.
kunye.yer: Düzada · Harbour quarter · by the pier
kunye.metin: A game from the Düzada universe
yenilik.mutfak: Only kitchen items go in the kitchen; blue-white tiles. Fridge and shelf can now be moved.
yenilik.arkaTezgah: Shop → Back counter: choose what stands behind the counter (coffee machine, blender, fruit…).
yenilik.isik: Lamps over the counter; wall lamp in the shop.
yenilik.mesai: The clock keeps running after closing; helpers get overtime pay.
yenilik.vitrin: A real gelato display: ice cream sinks in the tub as it sells.
yenilik.stok: Stock: sold-out items aren't ordered; refill everything at the end of the day.
yenilik.cikis: Quit and Full screen in the pause menu.
yenilik.insaat: Building mode asks what you want to do: move the counter, windows and doors.
kod.gonder: Move this shop to another device
kod.al: Load a code from another device
kod.kopyalandi: Code copied. Send it to yourself and paste it on the other device.
kod.kopyalanamadi: Couldn't copy; select the text in the box and copy it.
kod.yapistir: Paste the code here (starts with DK1:)
kod.uyari: This will replace the shop on this device.
kod.bozuk: Couldn't read the code. Make sure you copied all of it.
kod.kayitYok: There's no saved shop on this device.
kod.not: The code is the shop's save at that moment; after playing on the other device, make a new code to move it back. The photo album isn't moved.
yenilik.yerel: Local items for the back counter: Turkish tea glasses, Turkish coffee cups, cezve, double teapot, electric kettle.
yenilik.icecekler: The drinks stand grew: tea, ayran, lemonade, coffees, milkshake, fresh orange juice
bulut.hata.yazma: Couldn't save to the cloud; your save is still on this device
bulut.secimNot: The save on this device and the one in the cloud are different. The one you don't pick is deleted.
haber.hava.gunesli: The sky cleared, the sun is out
haber.hava.sicak: It's getting hot; lots of people will want cold drinks
haber.hava.bulutlu: Clouds rolled in, the wind picked up
haber.hava.yagmurlu: It started raining; a few fewer customers
yenilik.hava: Weather: sunny, very hot, cloudy and rainy days; tomorrow's forecast at the end of the day
dekor.cekicilikEtki: the higher it is, the more often customers come
yenilik.konfor: Items now have comfort and appeal: comfort raises satisfaction, appeal brings customers more often
haber.gedikliOldu: A customer loved it; they're a regular now. They'll be back for {cesit}
yenilik.gedikli: Regulars: very happy customers come back now and then for their favourite flavour
yenilik.duvarDeseni: Wall patterns: cone, fruit and striped wallpaper (Look → Inside walls)
yenilik.esyaRengi: Pick the tablecloth, parasol and cushion colour while placing
